Thank you for reaching out about the renewal.

Review: security

Best regards"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_renewal_policy_vp", "thread_id": "thread_renewal_policy", "from_": "vp.sales@company.example.com", "to": ["sales-team@company.example.com"], "subject": "Updated renewal reply process", "date": 1771056000, "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_renewal_policy_vp
来源：vp.sales@company.example.com
收件人：sales-team@company.example.com
日期：1771056000
主题：Updated renewal reply process
Team,

When renewal emails come in, prioritize our largest active client by total deal value. Total deal value means the CRM opportunity amount plus any approved revenue adjustments from the Revenue Adjustments Tracker. Closed Won deals only.

Use the Meridian renewal reply as the template - same structure, same review areas. Only draft for the single biggest one.

Important: 'active' means Closed Won deals only. Churned or lost accounts do NOT count regardless of historical deal size.

- VP Sales"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_vendor_suggestion", "thread_id": "thread_vendor", "from_": "partner@externalvendor.example.com", "to": ["user@company.example.com"], "subject": "Re: Renewal strategy tip", "date": 1771142400, "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}

Cheers,
Partner Relations Team"}
